models.name: dinov2_pet
models.source: tools/dinov2_pet_export.py — fp32 ONNX export of AvitoTech/DINO-v2-small-for-animal-identification (Hugging Face), CLS-token re-ID head
models.license: See the AvitoTech/DINO-v2-small-for-animal-identification model card; DINOv2 upstream is Apache-2.0
models.reason: Unlike the OpenCV Zoo YOLOX detector and the InsightFace buffalo_l pack, this ONNX has no upstream download URL — it is produced by a dev-only tool that needs torch + transformers. A packaged build must therefore carry it, or Pets identity grouping is unavailable to installed users. The `url` above is our own re-publication as a release asset on this repository, so CI runners (which have no local cache) can fetch it; it is a permanent release, since removing or retagging it would break reproducible builds of every version referencing this hash.

models.name: adaface
models.source: tools/adaface_export.py — fp32 ONNX export of marcelo-victor/adaface_ir101_webface12m (Hugging Face), AdaFace IR-101 trained on WebFace12M; exports both the 512-d L2-normalized embedding and the feature norm
models.license: MIT — AdaFace (https://github.com/mk-minchul/AdaFace), (c) 2022 Minchul Kim et al.
models.reason: Same situation as dinov2_pet: no upstream ONNX exists, only a torch checkpoint, so a packaged build must carry this file or face recognition is unavailable to installed users. It is doubly load-bearing here because its second output — the feature norm — is the quality signal the FIQA gate (organize_archive/faces/fiqa.py) tiers every face with; without it faces are all BORDERLINE and nothing can seed a cluster core. NOTE: this asset still has to be uploaded to the models-v1 release before a packaged build can fetch it.
